$comment: S1 diagnosis videos (Issue #22). Staff-recorded evaluation clips, kept in the repository; the same-day deletion rule applies to visitor recordings only (demo-plan Ua). Left / right are as seen in the video frame (camera view), not the person's own left / right: box_a = the tray on the left of the frame, box_b = the one on the right. Gold is written by the lead from 1 fps contact sheets; the human check of Cosmos' sentence against these facts is the GPU part of Issue #22. A re-take or an edit gets a new version with the reason and the old hash; entries are never replaced silently.

conditions.camera: phone on a fixed stand across the table from the person, tilted down; only the table, hands and forearms in frame, no face
conditions.scene: dark wooden table, plain wall; red cube and blue cube about 4 cm; two identical white trays at the far edge of the table
conditions.left_right: as seen in the frame: box_a = left tray, box_b = right tray
conditions.source_format: mp4 H.264, coded 720x1280 with a 90 degree rotation tag (displayed 1280x720), 24 fps, 11.25-11.5 s of video, AAC audio
conditions.preprocessing: ffmpeg 6.1.1: rotation applied, last 10.0 s of the video stream kept (only the idle lead-in is cut; every action lies inside), audio and metadata dropped: ffmpeg -ss <video_duration - 10> -i <source> -t 10 -an -map_metadata -1 -vf scale=1280:720,format=yuv420p -r 24 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 20 -bitexact -movflags +faststart <path>

gold.facts: Red cube front left, blue cube front centre, both trays empty. A right hand grasps the red cube, lifts it and puts it into the left tray; the hand leaves. The blue cube is not touched. Completed: the red cube rests in the left tray at the end.

Separate take from s1-01 with other start positions: blue cube front left, red cube at the right edge of the frame (partly cut off), both trays empty. A right hand grasps the blue cube, carries it across and puts it into the right tray; the hand leaves. The red cube is not touched. Completed: the blue cube rests in the right tray at the end.

Red cube centre left, blue cube front right, both trays empty. A hand lifts the red cube and puts it back at about the same place; then the hand touches the blue cube and shifts it slightly. Nothing is put into either tray; both trays are empty at the end. Unregistered action (lift and return), so no executable plan; needs_review is also acceptable as long as no executable plan is returned (demo-plan G2).
